close_reason: Added one-line purpose comment per email fixture block in seed.rs
description: seed.rs has 16 email fixtures with logical names like 'plain-simple' and 'html-attachment', but no per-fixture comment explains what RFC 8621 or jmap-test-suite scenario each fixture is designed to exercise. The module doc says 'derived from jmap-test-suite seed-data spec' but individual blocks have no traceability comment. A new contributor adding a conformance test can't tell which fixture covers a given scenario, or whether an existing fixture already covers it. Fix: add a one-line comment per email block stating its test purpose (e.g., '// plain-text single-part email; exercises basic get/query'). Distinct from bx3z.7 which covers the missing URL at module level.
title: seed.rs: per-email fixture purpose undocumented
